Mira Chen: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone snapshot. Fast answers please: what shipped, what slipped, and immediate owners for next steps? Trying to update the OKR doc before EOD.

Jordan Patel: EmbedCache rollout finished last week. PR #5012 merged, canary ran for 48h with no regressions. Owner: Jordan. Next: cut release to dedicated pool. ETA 2 days.

Alex Gomez: Runtime v2 latency SLO — we missed target on 99p for long sequences. Root cause: kernel fallback on quantized paths. Slipped from M2 to M3. Owner: Alex + eng-runtime.

Taylor Reed: Dedicated autoscaling policy PR is ready (RFC in doc). Blocked on infra quota approval. Owning follow-up is Taylor. Notes: quota ticket #876.

Sam: Small GA docs for the model catalog shipped today. Owner: Sam. Remaining: add routing examples.

Jordan Patel: Also FYI — canary for EmbedCache needs a rollback flag default on in console until release. Created ticket #912.

deploy-bot: deploy status: embedcache canary -> 48h green, staging->prod roll expected 2024-06-21.

Mira Chen: OK — owners: Jordan (EmbedCache roll), Alex (Runtime SLO fix), Taylor (autoscale quota), Sam (docs+routing). Can we get short owners' next-steps + ETA in one line each?

Alex Gomez: Next steps: reproduce KV fallback locally, add kernel switch and perf benchmark, ETA 2 weeks (M3). PR target: #5040.

Jordan Patel: Next steps: schedule prod release window with infra, add rollback toggle in console, ETA 2 business days.

Taylor Reed: Next: ping infra, escalate quota ticket, and schedule canary window, ETA 3 days.

Sam: Next: add routing examples and one pager, publish updates to docs, ETA EOD tomorrow.

Mira Chen: Thanks. If anything needs product sign-off for rollback/behavior changes ping me @mira. I'll update the OKR doc and mark the slipped item with mitigation plan.

Alex Gomez: Noted. I'll post a short perf diff to the OKR doc.

Jordan Patel: Adding the rollback flag PR link in the thread when ready :thumbsup:

Taylor Reed: +1 ; will loop infra and follow up in #eng-infra.

Sam: done, PR link posted for docs. :tada:

Mira Chen: Great — small sync Friday 11am if needed, otherwise we'll close this async. Thanks team.
